selector-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed selector. Angular Material is gone (NAS-141025) — every `mat-*`/`mdc-*` selector is dead and can never match, so it is a leftover to delete, not to keep. Use the `tn-*` element instead (`tn-icon` for `mat-icon`), and style the `tn-dialog` overlay via its `panelClass` and `.tn-dialog-panel` rather than `mat-dialog-*`/`mdc-dialog-*`. `.tn-list-item__*` is internal @truenas/ui-components markup — use (or add) a mixin in src/assets/styles/mixins/tn-list.scss instead, see "Known Library Gaps" in TRUENAS_UI_INTEGRATION.md.
